about: Custom types P2: raid_save_reload with a front row of 40 wolves (harness_type_a) and a back row of 150 hobgoblins. Saved and reloaded on the outbound leg, both rows must come back as they were: a live row entry is {mon_type: 21 (the entry kind), unit_data: {mon_type, class}, num}, and a load remap that reads or rewrites the top-level 21 breaks every row (Review Focus 1). The raid then comes home.

steps.why: the raid is still out after the reload
